propositions: The _rebar_repo_template fixture asserts absence of .rebar directory but does not assert the template contains no tickets, leaving a gap for tests run with narrowed scopes like pytest tests/interfaces/store.

Adding a no-tickets assertion at fixture construction time (inside MonkeyPatch context where REBAR_ROOT is pinned) provides per-worker protection before any test runs, versus relying on a single test that may not be selected.

The assertion rebar.list_tickets() == [] must execute inside the MonkeyPatch context because it requires REBAR_ROOT and cwd to be pinned at the template; the existing .rebar check runs after context exit and remains a plain filesystem test.

Tests in tests/interfaces/queries/test_recent_session_logs.py and tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_session_log_capture.py depend on template emptiness to assert correct session-log counts; pre-seeding the template without this assertion would silently break those assertions.
